If this were my problem, I would act on **Reply 1** first. 

The essential first step for diagnosing a CI-specific locator timeout is obtaining the CI artifact (trace or screenshot) from a failing run to see what the page actually rendered. Reply 1 directs the reader to configure artifact retention and inspect the failure trace immediately before making any changes. In contrast, Reply 2 delays getting artifacts behind a historical audit of prior runs and recommends capturing traces only on retry (`on-first-retry`). Furthermore, Reply 1 advocates for a safe, incremental feature-by-feature repository restructure rather than a high-risk single "moves-only" PR.
